findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "working_hours" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Tell whether a specific datetime falls within standard working hours for an emirate/sector, taking into account weekends, holidays, the federal Friday half day …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
